decisions.boundary_condition: Treat the pool and exercise facility as the durable core preference and the hot tub as a softer longitudinal preference. When the current request explicitly says that a pool, hot tub, and fitness center are all required, enforce the complete three-amenity bundle for that search. Do not infer indoor versus outdoor pool requirements, a specific pool type, or unrelated room amenities.

canonical_value.hot_tub: preferred_when_available; required when explicitly stated for the current search

decisions.condition: When choosing or comparing hotels based on wellness or recreation amenities.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels that offer both a pool and an on-site fitness center, gym, or comparable exercise facility; among otherwise suitable options, prefer one that also has a hot tub.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax the hot-tub preference when it materially limits suitable options only if the current request has not made it mandatory. Relax either core amenity when the user explicitly waives it or stronger current-trip constraints favor another hotel; if an explicitly required amenity bundle has no match, confirm with the user before relaxing it.
decisions.name: prefers_hotels_with_pool_fitness_and_optional_hot_tub
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with both a pool and an on-site fitness facility, with a hot tub as an additional preference when available unless the current search explicitly requires all three amenities.
decisions.rationale: These candidates express the same recurring hotel wellness-amenity policy. The pool-and-fitness candidate captures the durable core, while the all-three candidate supplies stronger hot-tub evidence for searches where that amenity is explicitly required. Merging them into the frozen representative preserves a soft longitudinal default without weakening explicit current-trip requirements.
